items.question: Can Omani buyers buy an apartment in Dubai?

items.answer: Compare the building as carefully as the unit: usable layout, maintenance quality, service charges, facilities and everyday access. Similar asking prices can hide very different long-term ownership costs.
items.question: What should Omani buyers check first when considering a Dubai apartment?

items.answer: For this scenario, compare Business Bay, JVC, Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai. These are starting points rather than a ranking; check the exact property and practical fit before deciding.
